description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating three token copies of Esika's Chariot.
When the Esika's Chariots enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger, creating 18 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar six times by sacrificing six tokens, adding {6}.
Repeat.
